metadata.qualification: Ten fixed real-text prompts, 24-73 input tokens and 128 outputs; no long-context inference. Unchanged independently qualified programs. Uninstrumented throughput uses one warmup and three samples. Separate synchronized phase attribution adds boundaries and CUDA events; its residual is not a prediction of full-round capture speedup. Fixed-input verifier graph replay is a diagnostic, not generation. All diagnostic generations and verifier replays must match their uninstrumented speculative outputs exactly. No task accuracy claim.
